description: Full app capability for secondary workspace windows (multi-monitor). A workspace window runs the entire soluterminal frontend — terminal panes, the preview tile, custom titlebar, dialogs/notifications — so it mirrors the main window's permission set. The `remote.urls` block is load-bearing: the frontend is served from the local solud daemon (not bundled with Tauri), so without listing those origins every plugin:* / custom-command invoke() from this window is silently denied by the ACL.
